title: Good place for an introduction to flamenco
text: We were lucky that we could hear the flamenco performance on the ground floor while looking around.  It added to the visit.  Wonderful costumes and information.
author: 593sheilab

title: Interesting museum!
text: I did not attend the show, I only visited the Museum... Anyway, during my visit, I still managed to stare at the stage, which can be seen from the top floor, and see and hear a bit of the flamenco number, which seemed pretty good to me! The museum itself is funny and interesting, with its various sections, where we can discover some facts and curiosities about this dance and its accessories! I really liked the cellar and took the opportunity to buy a CD at the souvenir shop! 😊
author: iladioamado

title: Very interesting museum
text: Really enjoyed this museum, even though we had very little knowledge of flamenco.  The displays and videos gave us an understanding of the history of flamenco, the different styles of dance and information about particular performers.  We didn’t have time to see a show, but the performance space looked lovely and you would need to book in advance as tickets had sold out
author: Gill W

title: Museo del flamenco molto bello!
text:
Very nice museum, with many exhibition rooms, videos, explanatory panels, typical clothes.
I really enjoyed the museum and its many rooms, it was just a nice journey into the world of flamenco between the music in the background and the images that surrounded us. Bello!
author: am0reepsiche

title: Highly recommended small museum to immerse you in Flamenco in a short visit in the heart of Seville.
text: An intimate and beautifully designed museum that gives you a wonderful immersion in the history and beauty of flamenco. An immersive theater makes you feel like you are at a real performance. What a treat.
author: SavoringTheGoodLife

title: Awesone show
text:
I could give this 10 stars if allowed. We watched the flamenco show and not really did the museum. The things that I liked; no phones allowed for pictures or recording and the small intimate location.
What I loved, the enthusiasm and passion of the singers and the dancers. The whole show was simply out of the world. You can see that the ones in it actually love what they do and they do the best every single time.
One advice I would give is to get there at least 30 min in advance to get the good seats in the front.
This is a absolute "must do" to attend and enjoy. Please go if you get a chance.
author: lquadros

title: Great
text: The history, preservation of the art form was demonstrated with local pride. Very unique and worthwhile. Gift shop great. Bought a CD but wanted a poster of a dancer that was not for sale.
author: G113FCchristineb

title: Best Flamenco show in Seville
text: We saw a 60minute Flamenco show with 6 incredibly talented performers. The performance space is intimate so you can really appreciate the athleticism of the dancers. The guitarist was brilliant - overall a fabulous show.
author: mrb2097

title: Heart beat of Andalucia
text: Modern museum that explores flamenco historically (a feat in dance art) and culturally.  Rare film clips. Completely absorbing. And a beautifully designed space. Well worth the visit.
author: RosinaLouise

title: MUST DO! INTIMATE FLAMENCO! Do not miss!
text: I can not recommend this highly enough. This was absolute perfection. We did the “intimate flamenco” it was 37 euros including one drink. The performers were so close the skirts touched our knees as the dancer spins. Get there 40 min early to get best seat but there are no bad seats. The guitarist was incredible. The 2 singers were incredible. The dancers were incredible. GO GO GO!!! :)
author: KellySanDiego
